name: TrinaTracker Buildex
specialisedFor: utility-scale solar construction: lifting PV modules and placing them on tracker racking
summary: PV module installation robot from the tracker business unit of Trinasolar. It picks, carries, aligns and places solar modules on fixed or tracker brackets, using AI vision and 3D cameras.

germany.statusNote: Announced in September 2026 by the Chinese maker. The trade report names no price, seller, distributor or customer, and no German or EU sales route was found.

specs.label: Installation rate
specs.conditions: up to; maker claim, said to be three to four times faster than manual labour
specs.quote: it can install up to 90 modules per hour, which is three to four times faster than manual labour

specs.label: Platform levelling
specs.quote: the height-adjustable robotic base has 17° platform levelling capability

specs.label: Brackets and modules
specs.value: fixed and tracking brackets; 1P and 2P modules
specs.quote: works with fixed and tracking brackets as well as 1P and 2P modules

specs.label: Positioning
specs.value: AI vision positioning and industrial 3D cameras
specs.quote: utilises AI vision positioning and industrial 3D cameras to adapt to complex terrain and different tracker layouts

notes: The report does not describe the running gear or the module gripper; legs, wheels and tracks are left false because nothing is sourced, and arms 1 with a gripper is the minimum implied by 'picking, transportation, alignment and placement'.
Maker says it can operate around the clock, which is a claim, not a measured runtime.
Adapts to complex terrain and different tracker layouts (maker).

evidence.task: Picks, carries, aligns and places solar modules on tracker or fixed brackets in utility-scale solar plants
evidence.note: Launch announcement by TrinaTracker; no site is named.
